stage: Stage 6 input consistency audit; not physical calibration or action evaluation

coordinates.depth: stored uint16 times per-frame depth_scale gives camera Z in mm; zero is invalid
coordinates.pixel_centers: integer u,v, as BOP misc.py; right/down/forward
coordinates.rigid_pose: original cam_R_m2c and cam_t_m2c; no recenter, fit, correction or orthogonalization

tolerance_basis: numerical/serialization sanity limits, not sensor error bounds. 1e-5 rigid-matrix checks allow finite serialization precision but reject scale/reflection; original 1e-14 m2 area requirement retained at physical units. Synthetic controls and independent implementation must verify these before actual execution.
mesh: require finite indexed triangles; exact-coordinate classes for diagnosis only; every undirected edge has exactly two opposite incidences; preserve raw vertices and faces; no welding, removal, variant substitution or global self-intersection certificate
masks: GT-dependent oracle annotation, not independent learned segmentation. Decode visible and full masks separately; require visible subset of full, binary 0/255, exact association by frame and GT index. Always intersect with valid positive depth; missing-depth pixels remain unknown.

diagnostic.selection: uniform integer indices across row-major valid-depth AND visible-mask pixels; retain all if fewer; no depth-residual or geometry filtering
diagnostic.ray: first positive two-sided triangle hit for selected object only, camera Z parameter; no solid containment
diagnostic.mesh_failure: skip geometric residual for that object but retain camera/image checks and both case records
diagnostic.residual_m: observed Z minus model-surface ray Z; record missing intersections, signed values, median absolute error and max absolute error; no outlier removal
diagnostic.other_scene_geometry: all five annotated models audited; per-object rays are not whole-scene or robot collision labels

disconfirmation: All ten records retained. A failed gate pauses this route without frame/object/model replacement or threshold tuning. Even numerical pass cannot establish sensor/pose uncertainty; no completion or physical/free-space claim follows. No Q13 automatic succession.
